ram_profile.method: subprocess synthetic RNG forward per size; 1 thread
interpretation: Isolated 320x320 forward SUCCEEDS with maxrss ~1665 MiB on 1.9 GiB host.
Peak scales strongly with input area (144→664, 288→1474, 320→1665 MiB maxrss).
Full-job 256/32 OOM remains consistent with forward peak near ceiling PLUS base/canvas/runtime headroom — not disproved; refined from pure "320 cannot forward".
Canvas 7168x4032 uint8 alone is small vs forward peak.

full_job_profile.invocation: runs the exact run_siax_upscale path in a child process; stage callbacks cover model_load, input_preprocess, tile_forward, tile_postprocess, output_stitch, final_encode and metadata_write
full_job_profile.caveat: RSS sampling and stage-boundary HWM are not a hard real-time memory guarantee; the first tile transient may still exceed a small host's limit
full_job_profile.device_metrics: CUDA allocated/reserved/peak allocation are recorded separately when device=cuda

spm_a.note: Real Siax residual vs Lanczos on fixed 48x64 probes — fingerprint bank, not full-frame rank.
spm_a.comparison_scope: 48 actual Siax crops vs Lanczos; fixed geometry; no per-cell full-output residual comparison has yet been run
